Dit ga je doen

Jij loopt voor de troepen uit en bent bezig met de technische oplossingen en integratie van applicaties voor de Rechtspraak. Hoe pakken we bepaalde vraagstukken aan, bijvoorbeeld met containerplatforms, microservices of object-based storage? Hoe gaan we om met systeemkoppelingen? En welke eisen stellen we, by design, aan de kwaliteit en veiligheid? Met de overgang naar de cloud en een zero trust architectuur ligt de lat hoog.

Jij werkt voor een of meer van onze DevOps-teams aan de architectuur van diverse applicaties die we zelf ontwikkelen, beheren en voortdurend vernieuwen. Denk aan toepassingen voor digitale rechtzaakdossiers, het uitwisselen van berichten of aan webportalen die externe partijen toegang geven tot onze informatie. Je zet het ontwerp in grote lijnen voor ze uit in een solution architectuur design en beantwoordt vragen bij de detailinvulling. Zo kunnen we agile werken aan een just-in-time architectuur.

Daarnaast werk je samen met ál onze architecten bij IVO Rechtspraak, dat geeft een extra dimensie aan je werk. Jullie zorgen voor samenhang binnen de totale architectuur van de Rechtspraak. Jij bent daarbij de brug naar je DevOps-team(s) en vertaalt de architectuurstatements van onze domeinarchitecten naar concrete uitwerkingen.

Over de functie

In het kort: Je gaat als senior .NET backend ontwikkelaar mobiele backends en API’s voor iOS- en Android-apps bouwen, optimaliseren en beveiligen, nauw samenwerken met het appteam en kwaliteit, performance en toegankelijkheid borgen.

Opdrachtomschrijving

Het MCC ontwikkelt momenteel apps met MAUI technologie maar zit in transitie naar native technologie (Swift/Swift-UI en Android Kotlin/Jetpack Compose). Jij bent Senior DotNet (app) backend ontwikkelaar met kennis van mobile ontwikkelplatforms voor het ontwikkelen van backends voor mobiele oplossingen voor Apple en Android. Daarnaast zie je jezelf als een ontwikkelaar met kennis en ervaring met het ontwikkelen van API's, hoogbeschikbare en hoogperformance systemen, databases (SQL-server) en authenticatiekennis (JWT).

Samen met de rest van ons deels MAUI en deels native ontwikkelteam werk je aan het vertalen van concepten naar technisch uitvoerbare code, waarbij je de nadruk legt op prestatieoptimalisatie, de ontwikkeling van intuïtieve gebruikersinterfaces en een naadloze integratie van services. Kwaliteitsborging staat centraal in je werk; je voert uitgebreide tests uit om de stabiliteit, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid van de apps te waarborgen.

Achtergrond Opdracht

Het Mobile Competence Center Belastingdienst ontwikkelt mobiele oplossingen op basis van het ontwikkelplatformen (development Apple (Swift) en Android (Kotlin) mobiele apps i.c.m. .Net back-ends voor Burgers Bedrijven (extern) en voor medewerkers (intern), daarnaast ontwikkelen wij ook Apps voor de Rijksdienst (ministeries) voor de mobiel platformen iOS en Android. Daar horen grote, kleine en creatieve opdrachten bij. De Belastingdienst draagt bij aan een financieel gezond Nederland. Dat doen we door eerlijk en zorgvuldig belasting te heffen en te innen. Met deze missie zorgen we ervoor dat er in Nederland geld is voor onder meer zorg, onderwijs en openbaar vervoer. Onze visie helpt ons om onze taken uit te voeren in een steeds veranderende samenleving. De IV- organisatie van de Belastingdienst is verantwoordelijk voor en verzorgt de ICT-voorzieningen. Dit gebeurt deels door gebruik te maken van de expertise die intern aanwezig is, maar ook door het aantrekken van (kant-en-klaar) oplossingen en expertise uit de markt.

jobs.title: MES/MOM Developer
jobs.description:
Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.

GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.

Job Summary

As MES/MOM engineer at GKN Aerospace in Papendrecht, The Netherlands, you will be involved in the Development, Implementation, Validation and Support of our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solution based on Siemens Opcenter Execution, deployed at sites in the APAC, EU and NA regions.

Job Responsibilities

Support and maintain current MES deployments in multiple Production sites.
Package and deploy new GKN customization releases to Test and Production environments.
Install/upgrade and configure Opcenter for new implementations and deployments.
Set up and maintain integrations with surrounding applications using Opcenter Connect MOM.
Understand business processes and functional requirements and convert into technical specifications.
Translate functional and design specifications into MES objects: workflows, equipment classes, etc.
Develop custom logic when justified by a valid business case and no out of the box solution is available.
Define test specifications, participate in tests and validation.
Develop tools and templates to speed up the design process, make the support process more efficient and increase application stability and usability.
Conduct technical training when required to share development best practices.

Job Qualifications

To help us make a difference, you’ll bring your passion and talent for what you do along with the following skills, experience, qualifications and attributes:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or equivalent work experience.
Minimum of 5 years of working experience in a similar role.
Extensive experience in Windows server administration, application management and configuration including IIS, certificates, services, firewall, Powershell.
Experience with Kubernetes and managing applications running as Docker Containers an
Extensive experience in Oracle/MS SQL database management and query methods.
Experience with Siemens Opcenter Execution (formerly known as Camstar), including Designer, Portal Studio, Opcenter Connect MOM or similar experience.
Experience with Mendix development.
Knowledge of basic programming languages such as .NET, HTML, C++/C#, XML/XSL/XSD, VB Script.
Experience in supporting and troubleshooting applications, ideally in the field of manufacturing or production.
Experience in supporting the implementation of software solutions and participating in IT projects.
Strong commitment and responsibility to maintain and support production environments.
Eagerness to expand current knowledge and learn new skills.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills, Dutch would be a plus.
Ability to work in multi-cultural environments, team player.
Willingness to travel.

What do we offer?

We are committed to offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities, a career that can go in many directions thanks to our breadth of international opportunities. By being part of GKN Fokker Aerospace that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry, you will know that you will be working towards being the most trusted partner in the aerospace industry.

Role

In the role of MES\MOM Systems Developer/Engineer you will belong to an international team of experts. We will not only provide you with the conditions to perform at the best of your capabilities, but we will also support and promote your professional and personal development. Furthermore, we will offer you:

A gross monthly salary in scale K for a medior at € 3.952 up to € 5.715,- depending on your work experience,
8% holiday allowance,
40 paid holidays for full-time employment in line with the Collective Labor Agreement Metalektro (27 holidays and 13 ADV days),
An excellent pension scheme (PME) and travel allowance,
Hybrid working, giving you the opportunity to balance home and office working,
Profit sharing scheme,
A pleasant and informal working environment, in which we work together to achieve the best result for our customers.

Next to a competitive package, we will offer you a world of opportunities: we want to see your career fly! We will support your career progression by providing you with learning and development opportunities. That's the beauty of being part of a global business, once you're on board you never know where your career journey may take you!

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go?

A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working

Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN. We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work.

We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know.

We are the place where human dreams, plus human endeavour, shape the future of aerospace innovation and technology.

Als Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Developer (m/w/d) entwickelst du kundenindividuelle Lösungen mit C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript und sorgst dafür, dass aus fachlichen Anforderungen saubere, nachhaltige technische Lösungen entstehen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kunden und Projektteams zusammen und bringst dein Senior-Know-how aktiv in unsere Projekte und unser Team ein.

Tätigkeiten

Microsoft Dynamics 365 (CRM): Du berätst unsere Kunden bei anspruchsvollen CRM-Projekten, analysierst ihre Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales / Customer Service / Marketing / Field Service).
Lösungsdesign & Entwicklung: Du konzipierst und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen mit C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript und legst dabei großen Wert auf sauberen Code, Qualität und Wartbarkeit.
Anforderungen technisch übersetzen: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und Consultants zusammen, verstehst fachliche Anforderungen und überführst sie in durchdachte technische Konzepte.
Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Du bewertest Lösungswege, unterstützt bei der Priorisierung technischer Themen und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte strukturiert und zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.
Wissen weitergeben: Du teilst deine Erfahrung im Team, unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei komplexen Fragestellungen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer technischen Standards ein.
Workshops & Kundentermine: Du bringst deine technische Expertise in Workshops, Präsentationen und Pitch-Terminen ein und hilfst so dabei, Kunden von unseren Lösungen zu überzeugen und neue Projekte zu gewinnen.

Anforderungen

Ausbildung: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (B.Sc. / M.Sc.) mit dem Schwerpunkt (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine Ausbildung mit vergleichbarer Qualifikation. Wichtiger als dein schulischer Werdegang ist uns aber, dass du fachlich stark bist und Verantwortung übernehmen willst.
Erfahrung: Du hast bereits mehrere Beratungs- und Umsetzungsprojekte im CRM-/Business-Software-Umfeld erfolgreich begleitet und fühlst dich besonders in der technischen Konzeption und Umsetzung sicher. L'opportunité

Développer la plateforme Unity consiste à concevoir, bâtir, tester et maintenir les systèmes qui permettent aux développeur(se)s de livrer et d'exploiter des jeux en direct à grande échelle. L'équipe Diagnostics fait partie de l'organisation LiveOps de Unity et est responsable des données qui indiquent aux créateur(rice)s comment leurs jeux se comportent réellement sur le terrain : rapports de plantage du runtime Unity, télémétrie et observabilité à travers les projets clients, analyses de la santé des produits, ainsi que les surfaces du Tableau de bord Unity qui redonnent ces données aux développeur(se)s.

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(se) logiciel Sénior pour se joindre à l'équipe Diagnostics en tant que généraliste à dominante backend. Il/elle va diriger la conception de bout en bout à travers notre pile — ingestion depuis des millions de clients de jeux, Pipelines bâtis sur OpenTelemetry, un lac de données basé sur ClickHouse, et les surfaces de tableau de bord dont dépendent les client(e)s — et collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data, IAP, Profiler et DevX sur les intégrations qui rendent Diagnostics réellement utile. Notre pile est composée de Go (principalement), Kotlin, TypeScript et C#. Il s'agit d'une petite équipe autonome où le jugement sénior a un impact exponentiel : il/elle va définir la manière dont l'équipe conçoit, révise et livre ses solutions, y compris la façon dont nous utilisons les outils d'IA agentique comme partie intégrante de notre pratique de développement.

Ce que vous allez faire

Diriger la conception de bout en bout pour l'ingestion, les Pipelines, le stockage et les requêtes ClickHouse, ainsi que les tableaux de bord sur lesquels les développeur(se)s s'appuient.
Rédiger et maintenir des services Go de haute qualité capables de gérer à grande échelle des entrées contrôlées par des acteurs malveillants, avec une attention particulière à la fiabilité, à la performance et à la clarté des contrats de données.
Rehausser les standards de revue de code et de revue de résultats assistés par l'IA — définir les normes utilisées par l'équipe lorsqu'elle livre des travaux en collaboration avec des agents de codage.
Collaborer avec les différentes équipes (Data, IAP, Unity Profiler, DevX, Analytics) afin de concevoir des intégrations robustes en conditions de production et adaptées aux besoins réels des client(e)s.
Encadrer les développeur(se)s de l'équipe, partager largement les bons modèles, et décomposer des problèmes ambigus en parcours concrets maximisant la valeur.

Ce que nous recherchons

Avoir une expérience en production avec Go dans des services à haut débit, ainsi qu'une aisance sur un large éventail de tâches backend (ingestion, Pipelines, stockage et requêtes OLAP/colonnaires, tableaux de bord au besoin).
Démontrer un jugement de niveau sénior : avoir mené des conceptions transversales, rehaussé le niveau de développement, et mentoré les pairs et collaborateur(rice)s individuel(le)s autour de soi.
Posséder une réelle expérience pratique des flux de travail avec IA agentique : avoir utilisé des agents de codage (Claude Code, Codex, mode agent de Cursor, Gemini CLI ou équivalent) sur du travail concret, développé une opinion éclairée sur leurs compromis, et conçu des harnais, prompts ou sous-agents robustes face à la variance. Revoir les sorties de modèles avec la même rigueur que des revues de PR, et être capable de défendre chaque ligne de code en ses propres mots.
Avoir de l'expérience en conception et en interrogation de magasins de données NoSQL ou OLAP/colonnaires (ClickHouse est un atout), ainsi qu'une compréhension pratique de bout en bout des Pipelines de données.
Posséder d'excellentes aptitudes de collaboration et de communication, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre plusieurs équipes et fuseaux horaires.

Vous avez peut-être également

Manifester un intérêt sincère ou une expérience en observabilité et télémétrie (OpenTelemetry en particulier) — c'est notre cœur de métier.
Avoir une expérience front-end avec TypeScript et des contributions à des surfaces de type tableau de bord. Le backend est la priorité pour ce rôle; les compétences front-end sont un atout bienvenu, sans être une attente quotidienne.
Avoir une expérience en production avec Kotlin, ou une exposition à C# du côté du moteur.
Posséder un parcours dans le domaine du jeu vidéo — comprendre comment les développeur(se)s consomment les diagnostics, et ce que la performance et le profilage d'un jeu signifient concrètement pour eux/elles.
Adopter des habitudes responsables dans la gestion des données des utilisateur(rice)s : tenir compte des frontières de confiance, de la rétention, de la journalisation hygiénique (aucune donnée personnelle identifiable, aucun jeton, aucun contenu complet de charge utile) et de la modélisation des menaces avant d'implémenter une fonctionnalité.

Information supplémentaire

Le support à la relocalisation n'est pas disponible pour ce poste
Un visa de travail ou un parrainage de l'immigration n'est pas disponible pour ce poste

The opportunity

Developing the Unity platform means designing, building, testing, and maintaining the systems that empower developers to ship and operate live games at scale. The Diagnostics team sits inside Unity's LiveOps umbrella and is responsible for the data that tells creators how their games are actually behaving in the wild — crash reports from the Unity runtime, telemetry and observability across customer projects, product health analysis, and the Unity Dashboard surfaces that put that data back in developers' hands.

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the Diagnostics team as a backend-leaning generalist. You will lead end-to-end design across our stack — ingest from millions of game clients, pipelines built on OpenTelemetry, a ClickHouse-based data lake, and the dashboard surfaces customers depend on — and you will partner closely with the Data, IAP, Profiler, and DevX teams on the integrations that make Diagnostics useful. Our stack is Go (primary), Kotlin, TypeScript, and C#. This is a small, autonomous team where senior judgment compounds: you will shape how the team designs, reviews, and ships, including how we work with agentic AI tools as a core part of the craft.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead end-to-end design across ingest, pipelines, ClickHouse storage and query, and the dashboards developers rely on.
Write and maintain high-quality Go services that handle attacker-controlled inputs at scale, with strong attention to reliability, performance, and clean data contracts.
Raise the bar on code review and AI-assisted output review — set the norms the team uses when shipping work alongside coding agents.
Partner across teams (Data, IAP, Unity Profiler, DevX, Analytics) to design integrations that hold up under real production load and real customer needs.
Mentor engineers across the team, share patterns broadly, and decompose ambiguous problems into the highest-value path forward.

Production experience with Go in high-throughput services, plus comfort moving across a backend-leaning generalist surface (ingest, pipelines, OLAP/columnar storage and query, dashboards when needed).
Demonstrated senior-level judgment: a track record of leading cross-cutting design, raising the engineering bar, and mentoring peers and ICs around you.
Real, hands-on fluency with agentic AI workflows — you have used coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor agent mode, Gemini CLI, or similar) on real work, formed informed opinions about their trade-offs, and built harnesses, prompts, or sub-agents that hold up under variance. You review model output as rigorously as PR code, and can defend any line of it in your own words.
Experience designing for and querying NoSQL or OLAP/columnar data stores (ClickHouse a plus), and a working understanding of data pipelines end to end.
Excellent collaboration and communication, with the ability to work effectively across teams and time zones.

Genuine interest or experience in observability and telemetry (OpenTelemetry especially) — this is our bread and butter.
Front-end experience with TypeScript and contributions to dashboard-style surfaces. Backend is the primary lens for this role; front-end capability is a welcome bonus, not a daily expectation.
Production experience with Kotlin, or C# exposure on the engine side.
Gaming background — context for how developers consume diagnostics, what game performance and profiling actually mean to them.
Habits around handling user data responsibly: thinking about trust boundaries, retention, hygienic logging (no PII, no tokens, no full payloads), and threat-modeling features before writing them.

Relocation support is not available for this position
Work visa/immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

Chez Unity, nous voulons que nos membres d’équipe s’épanouissent. Nous offrons un large éventail d’avantages conçus pour soutenir le bien-être et l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle.

rozwijasz Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM od strony developerskiej, a nie wyłącznie konfiguracyjnej,
pracujesz zarówno z TypeScript, jak i C#/.NET, rozwijając logikę po stronie klienta i serwera,

rozwój pluginów C#/.NET odpowiedzialnych za logikę biznesową i customizacje encji,
implementację logiki obsługującej zdarzenia Create, Update i Delete,
rozwój integracji pomiędzy Dynamics 365 CRM a systemami zewnętrznymi z wykorzystaniem Azure Service Bus,
współpracę przy wdrożeniach aplikacji z wykorzystaniem wewnętrznych procesów CI/CD oraz narzędzi opartych o Power Apps,
dbanie o jakość kodu oraz stosowanie dobrych praktyk programistycznych.

masz komercyjne doświadczenie w rozwoju Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM,
bardzo dobrze znasz C#/.NET oraz TypeScript / JavaScript,
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu client-side customizacji formularzy Dynamics 365 CRM,
rozwijałeś/aś pluginy Dynamics 365 CRM oraz logikę biznesową po stronie serwera,
masz doświadczenie w integracji systemów z wykorzystaniem API lub kolejek komunikatów,

swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

doświadczenie z Azure Service Bus,
znajomość usług Microsoft Azure,
doświadczenie z Power Platform (Power Apps lub Power Automate),
znajomość procesów CI/CD oraz pracy z Git.

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz dzielenie się wiedzą w grupach kompetencyjnych,

elastyczność w zakresie godzin pracy i formy współpracy oraz możliwość korzystania z biur we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu i Gdańsku,

jobs.description:
About The Role

In this role, you will design and deliver enterprise AI/ML solutions for client engagements, with a primary focus on the Middle East and Central Asia. You will shape scalable and secure architectures across on-premises and hybrid environments, working with enterprise customers, technology partners, and delivery teams from use-case definition through production.

Responsibilities

Design end-to-end AI/ML solution architectures aligned with enterprise business, data, security, and infrastructure requirements
Lead AI initiatives from use-case definition and technical discovery through architecture, implementation, deployment, and transition to production
Define architectures for Generative AI, LLM, RAG, AI agents, and intelligent automation using NVIDIA and other enterprise technologies
Recommend appropriate AI technologies, frameworks, deployment approaches, and infrastructure sizing, including GPU-based environments
Collaborate with enterprise customers, technology partners, engineers, data scientists, and infrastructure teams throughout the solution lifecycle
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data platforms and technologies such as NVIDIA AI Enterprise, Cisco AI Defense, Splunk, IBM watsonx, and ServiceNow
Guide implementation teams to ensure scalability, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational readiness
Support technical discovery, customer workshops, solution estimation, and proposal development while applying AI engineering and MLOps best practices

2+ years of experience as a Solution Architect designing complex AI/ML solutions and 4+ years of technical leadership experience in Machine Learning or Data Science
Strong experience designing and delivering enterprise AI/ML solutions, including Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI agent architectures
Strong knowledge of on-premises and hybrid infrastructure, Kubernetes-based environments and/or VMware, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
Strong understanding of MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, AI lifecycle management, Python, and modern AI/ML frameworks
Experience with NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, or related NVIDIA AI technologies would be an advantage
Experience delivering AI solutions in the Middle East or Central Asia, regulated enterprise environments, or in collaboration with technology partners and OEMs would be an advantage
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead technical discovery and solution-design discussions with enterprise customers
Availability to travel up to 2–3 weeks per month, primarily for customer and partner engagements

masz komercyjne doświadczenie w rozwoju Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM,

jobs.description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.

We're looking for an experienced AI-First Senior Software Engineer
for our Stockholm office.

This is not a "coder" role. Our position is deliberate: the era ahead needs software engineers , not software developers . AI has hyper-accelerated the software cycle — but it cannot hold accountability. The engineer does. With AI handling most code generation, human attention becomes the scarce resource and moves upstream and downstream of the keyboard: to priorities, trade-off decisions, governance and final judgment, while agents handle execution in between.

Your job is to do what AI cannot — set direction, make the judgement calls, and keep acceleration from turning into compounding risk across functionality, security, compliance, maintainability and knowledge continuity. The Factory's goal is accelerated, secure and sustainable software delivery, and you are the person who holds that line.

What You'll Do

System design. Own the big picture — how components fit together, how data flows, how failures propagate. Modularity, standards and flexibility, not just the unit of code in front of you.
Domain modelling. Understand the client's business problem deeply enough to design the right solution, not just a working one. Widening the problem context is where the real advantage is.
Architectural patterns. Know which patterns to apply, when and why. As AI produces design artefacts faster than organisations can evaluate trade-offs, your role shifts toward decision engineering — choosing and validating, not just producing.
Process design — the core responsibility. Design the repeatable process by which software gets built, tested, deployed and maintained. In practice this means designing and orchestrating agentic coding flows, including patterns such as orchestrator–worker (an orchestrator decides sub-tasks, initiates them and synthesises results) and evaluator–optimizer (one model generates, a second evaluates and feeds back, and the loop iterates). You decide where a deterministic workflow is right versus a more autonomous agent.
Quality judgment. Know what good looks like, recognise when AI output is wrong, and have the discipline to reject it. Quality control moves from line-by-line review toward designing tests, feedback loops and validation checkpoints.
Tooling — the right tool for the job. Fluency across product-development tools, AI-acceleration (code-generation) tools, infrastructure tools and quality-control tools. The best results come when tools have full access to the specific codebase and knowledge base — and well-structured, standardised codebases yield the largest gains.
Accountability. You hold accountability — not the AI. Put bluntly: vibe coding is not software engineering.

Your profile

8+ years of hands-on software engineering, with deep fundamentals in architecture, system design, modularity and standards (non-negotiable — AI amplifies skill, it doesn't substitute for it)
An early adopter of AI-first development, with proven, in-production experience implementing AI-first software development processes — not just experimenting with tooling
Demonstrable experience designing and orchestrating agentic / AI-assisted development workflows (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer, and workflow-vs-agent decisions)
Strong critical evaluation of AI output and the discipline to reject it
Test design, feedback-loop design and validation skills over line-by-line review
Security, compliance and maintainability awareness in AI-accelerated pipelines
Infrastructure / CI-CD fluency and the ability to work across the full SDLC
Domain-modelling ability — translating a business problem into the right technical solution
Prompt and context engineering as a working skill, not a novelty
Strong collaboration and communication, with deep client and product integration
Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

Tools you'll work with

AI-acceleration: Claude Code, agentic coding tools and LLM platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI)
Languages & engineering: .NET, Java or Python at senior depth, with strong Git and code-review practice
Workflow orchestration: agent frameworks and multi-step orchestration (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer patterns)
Infrastructure: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes
Quality control: automated testing, evaluation and validation frameworks for AI-assisted output

Meritorious

Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
Experience standing up AI-first processes at team or organisation scale
LLM evaluation, guardrails and testing strategy experience
Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience

What this role is not

It is not a prompt-driven "code typist," and it is not someone who ships unreviewed AI output. Used incorrectly, AI tools make a codebase less reliable, and automated processes compound that risk. Your judgement, ownership and process design are the product.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is

Current Situation
The Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That
growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.

We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and
infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.

To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the
teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.

runs) and write up root cause analyses.

modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based
access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.
Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation

Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).

Identity & Access Management
